description: This file is a Markdown documentation (doc) for Event Hooks related to SSO Login integration in the LiteLLM project. It provides detailed explanations, usage instructions, and code snippets for customizing Single Sign-On handlers for LiteLLM, including custom UI SSO handlers that parse request headers and custom SSO handlers that process post-authentication logic.

classes.name: MyCustomSSOLoginHandler
classes.description: Custom handler class for parsing OAuth proxy headers to extract user info for LiteLLM's UI sign-in process.

methods.name: custom_sso_handler
methods.description: Custom SSO handler function invoked after user authenticates via a standard SSO provider, allowing custom logic and user info setup inside LiteLLM.
